I expanded the Narrative_DeterministicFallbackSlugGeneration (the narrative this document extends), Position_PipelineMissingIdSlugHandling (the position its two commitment-marker expressions bear on), and MemoryPipeline (the strata under which both the narrative and position sit). I deliberately did not expand ns__Decision_DiagnosticFirst, which is about Xena's consulting methodology and has no bearing on pipeline slug generation.
